+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+ORDER = ["Day (06:00–17:59)", "Night (18:00–05:59)"]
+COLORS = ["#377eb8", "#e07a35"]
+
+
+def save_chart(fig, option_id):
+    fig.savefig(OUT / f"option_{option_id}.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+    plt.close(fig)
+
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+period_case = "case when extract(hour from crash_time) >= 18 or extract(hour from crash_time) < 6 then 'Night (18:00–05:59)' else 'Day (06:00–17:59)' end"
+base = f"""
+    select {period_case} as period,
+           coalesce(number_of_persons_injured, 0) as injured,
+           coalesce(number_of_persons_killed, 0) as killed
+    from read_parquet(?)
+    where crash_time is not null
+"""
+periods = con.execute(
+    f"""with crashes as ({base})
+        select period, count(*) as reported_crashes,
+               sum(case when injured + killed > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as injury_or_fatal_crashes,
+               sum(injured) as people_injured, sum(killed) as people_killed,
+               sum(injured + killed) as people_injured_or_killed
+        from crashes group by period""",
+    [str(DATA)],
+).df().set_index("period").loc[ORDER].reset_index()
+
+start_date, end_date = con.execute(
+    "select min(crash_date), max(crash_date) from read_parquet(?)", [str(DATA)]
+).fetchone()
+date_note = f"Crash records, {start_date}–{end_date};"
+caveat = "no traffic-volume or trip/mileage exposure denominator"
+
+# Option 1: reported crash counts in equally long clock-time windows.
+v1 = periods[["period", "reported_crashes"]].copy()
+v1.to_csv(OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.4))
+bars = ax.bar(v1["period"], v1["reported_crashes"], color=COLORS, width=0.62)
+ax.set_title("More reported crashes occur in the daytime window", loc="left", weight="bold", pad=16)
+ax.set_ylabel("Police-reported crashes")
+ax.set_ylim(0, v1["reported_crashes"].max() * 1.18)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+for bar, value in zip(bars, v1["reported_crashes"]):
+    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, value, f"{value:,.0f}", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=11)
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"{date_note} each window spans 12 hours. Counts do not adjust for exposure ({caveat}).", fontsize=8.5)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.06, 1, 1))
+save_chart(fig, 1)
+
+# Option 2: share of reported crashes with at least one injury or death.
+v2 = periods[["period", "injury_or_fatal_crashes", "reported_crashes"]].copy()
+v2["injury_or_fatal_crash_pct"] = 100 * v2["injury_or_fatal_crashes"] / v2["reported_crashes"]
+v2.to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.4))
+for y, row, color in zip([1, 0], v2.to_dict("records"), COLORS):
+    val = row["injury_or_fatal_crash_pct"]
+    ax.hlines(y, 0, val, color=color, linewidth=3, alpha=0.75)
+    ax.plot(val, y, "o", color=color, markersize=11)
+    ax.text(val + 0.45, y, f"{val:.2f}%", va="center", weight="bold", fontsize=11)
+ax.set_yticks([1, 0], [ORDER[0], ORDER[1]])
+ax.set_xlim(0, max(v2["injury_or_fatal_crash_pct"]) * 1.25)
+ax.set_xlabel("Crashes with ≥1 person injured or killed (% of reported crashes)")
+ax.set_title("A larger share of nighttime crashes involved injury or death", loc="left", weight="bold", pad=16)
+ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, f"{date_note} windows: day 06:00–17:59; night 18:00–05:59. This is severity per crash, not exposure-adjusted risk ({caveat}).", fontsize=8.5)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.06, 1, 1))
+save_chart(fig, 2)
+
+# Option 3: total people injured or killed per 100 reported crashes.
+v3 = periods[["period", "people_injured_or_killed", "reported_crashes"]].copy()
+v3["people_injured_or_killed_per_100_crashes"] = 100 * v3["people_injured_or_killed"] / v3["reported_crashes"]
+v3.to_csv(OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f")
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.4))
+vals = v3["people_injured_or_killed_per_100_crashes"].tolist()
+bars = ax.barh(v3["period"], vals, color=COLORS, height=0.55)
+ax.invert_yaxis()
+ax.set_xlim(0, max(vals) * 1.25)
+ax.set_xlabel("People injured or killed per 100 reported crashes")
+ax.set_title("Nighttime crashes had a higher casualty burden per crash", loc="left", weight="bold", pad=16)
+ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+for bar, value in zip(bars, vals):

+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.06, 1, 1))
